name: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited
remarksWeb: The Board, at its meeting held on 12th August 2025, based on the recommendations of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee  approved the grant of 116,281 RSUs and 327,494 ESOPs aggregating to 443,775 units to eligible employees under the Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited  Employee Stock Option Plan 2024 (Apollo ESOP 2024) . This was disclosed to the stock exchanges on 12th August 2025.  The Company has since issued grant letters in the first tranche to 70 employees aggregating to 381,184 units ( 277,234 ESOPs and 103,950 RSUs) during March 2026. This grant was effective from 1st September 2025.
